help.tips[0].examples[0].en: Next I'd like to address the consequences, in so far as they can already be substantiated.
help.tips[0].examples[1].en: First, the starting point: the increasing use of digital media cannot be overlooked.
help.tips[0].check.whyEn: sein + zu + infinitive is the passive substitute that gives each part its formal density: nicht zu übersehen.
help.tips[0].en.text: Announce the plan; then, inside each part, one nominal phrase, one formal connector, one substitute: 'Zunächst zur Ausgangslage: Die zunehmende Nutzung digitaler Medien ist zu beobachten, zumal …'
help.tips[0].en.title: Structure first, then density
help.tips[1].examples[0].en: I concede the data are limited; I nevertheless consider the conclusion justifiable.

help.tips[1].check.whyEn: To concede is einräumen: Ich räume ein, dass … and then you defend your point with allerdings or dennoch.
help.tips[1].en.text: Das ist ein berechtigter Einwand; allerdings … · Sofern man … berücksichtigt, … · Ich räume ein, dass …, halte aber … für vertretbar.
help.tips[1].en.title: Defend with a concession and a condition
help.tips[2].examples[0].en: Proceeding from the results available, the following can be established.
help.tips[2].examples[1].en: Coming back to your question, I would like to give one more example.
help.tips[2].check.whyEn: The participial opener uses the Partizip I: von … ausgehend (proceeding from …).
help.tips[2].en.text: Auf die Frage zurückkommend, … / Von den Zahlen ausgehend, … — one at the start of an answer sounds polished and costs nothing.
help.tips[2].en.title: One participial clause, placed early
help.hookEn: Present an abstract topic in polished spoken German, and hold your ground calmly when someone pushes back.
help.introEn: The closing conversation of this module, in your own AI assistant with voice on: presenting an abstract topic (education, research, attention) in structured, formal spoken German, and defending it under questions. Copy the exercise in, say 'Los geht's', answer in full sentences; the score and corrections come at the end. The tutor listens for the markers of polished formal speech: an announced structure (zunächst – anschließend – abschließend), nominal phrases used with control (die Auswirkungen der Digitalisierung auf …), the formal connectors (sofern, zumal, insofern als, allerdings, hingegen), passive substitutes (ist zu bedenken, lässt sich feststellen), a participial or adverbial clause of each kind, and evaluative adjectives (nachvollziehbar, vertretbar). This is a talk and the discussion that follows it — at work, at university or at a public meeting — in rehearsal.
help.rememberEn[0]: Announce – nominal phrase – formal connector – substitute – concede – conclude.
help.rememberEn[1]: sofern, zumal, insofern als, allerdings: one per answer.
help.examEn: A structured talk followed by a discussion is the core of the C1 speaking exam — and of many meetings at work.
